title: Pip and the Jam
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds j, v, w

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing on a puddled garden path after rain.
Pip the sparrow standing beside a small clay pot left on the path.
A close view into the clay pot, showing a bright red jam inside.

pages.text: Pip has a peck of jam.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow leaning down to peck at the red jam in the pot.

pages.text: Pip has jam on his bill!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pulling back with bright red jam stuck all over his beak, looking surprised.

pages.text: Pip taps his bill on a mat.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tapping his jammy beak against a rough doormat on the path.
Pip the sparrow with a clean beak now, a smear of red jam left on the mat.

pages.text: Pip has fun. Pip gets jam.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow happily pecking at the pot of red jam again on the path.
